items.html: However, the rest of the Gevurot may be called so by way of extension; but the plain Botsina deKardinuta is this Gevura of Atik, hidden in this Mocha, and it is the root of all the Gevurot. And this is what it said in the portion of Pekudei, page 254, side B: "And see, the beginning of the faith within thought struck the Botsina deKardinuta," etc., whose matter was explained above, and it is that AA, which is the Rosh and beginning of the faith, was clarifying within his thought, which is the concealed Mocha, in which are all the clarifications of the seven kings in the aspect of MAN, in order to make from them the aspect of the Partzufim of AVI, for there is no clarification except in thought. And the Botsina deKardinuta, which is the Gevura of Atik, the root of all the Gevurot, with its power, the thought is able to clarify the aforementioned clarifications, for all the clarifications are the aspect of Gevurot, and therefore they are clarified through that Botsina deKardinuta.
